efficiency_scale.rule: The efficiency scale (ConsumeLiquid.java:43): ed is edelta times this scale; the canonical scale is 1.0 (SourceBuildingEfficiencyState.efficiency_scale_state).

multiplier.rule: The consumer multiplier (Consume.java:18): the 1f default -- the large def sets none (Blocks.java:3028 is a bare consumeLiquid call).

has_power_consumer.rule: Whether the block has a power consumer (Block.java:1449): the driver gate -- the row joins the first pass only when the block consumes power, and the power consumer counts toward hasConsumers.
